recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless a future work group decision specifically requests Appointment.account search parameters or altered appointment billing guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-24078 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Appointment and requested adding Appointment.account 0..* Reference(Account) to mirror Encounter for billing accounts expected from activities resulting from an Appointment, including pre-registration workflows.
initial_application: Git commit 2606e20d6dc7fdc21e21ceec5387a2d8832af950 explicitly applied #FHIR-24078 by adding Appointment.account to source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml with the requested cardinality, Reference(Account) target, definition, and comment.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists appointment=Appointment, putting the Appointment StructureDefinition in the current build. Encounter.account remains the parallel billing-account Reference(Account) element. Later FHIR-26961 appointment insurance guidance relies on Appointment.account rather than changing it, and that related issue is already represented on the combined branch. PA May 2021 Confluence minutes record the motion and 10-0-0 vote to make the FHIR-24078 change; direct Zulip key search found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because current authoritative source already implements the approved element and related narrative is consistent with it. Adding search behavior or extra prose would exceed the seed resolution and discovered evidence.
